## Sequence rarefaction

```{r}
read_matrix <- function(data, taxa_level){
  rm <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(taxa_level)) %>%
    summarize(reads=sum(set_read_count)) %>%
    ungroup()

  rm <- as.data.frame(pivot_wider(data=rm,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = reads,
                    values_fill = list(reads=0)))

  return(rm)

}

plot_rarecurve_plot <- function(data, taxa_level){
  read_counts <- read_matrix(data, taxa_level)
  
  rarecurve_data <- read_counts[,-1]
  rownames(rarecurve_data) <- read_counts[[taxa_level]]

  rarecurve <-  rarecurve(t(rarecurve_data), step = 500, 
                          label=FALSE, cex=0.2, tidy = TRUE)
  #return(rarecurve)
  
  colnames(rarecurve) <- c("Site", "Sample", "Taxa_level")
  rarecurve$cat <- ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", as.character(rarecurve$Site)), "2020-2021", "2024-2025")

  pal <- c("#7B71B6", "#E06666")

  plot <- ggplot(data=rarecurve, aes(x=Sample, y=Taxa_level, color=cat)) +
  geom_point(size=0.02) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pal) +
    facet_wrap(~cat) +
  labs(x="Sequences",
       y="Species") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  return(plot)
}
```

Do rarefraction curve to the whole data
```{r}

rarecurve_all
```

## Viral read proportions

Calcuate viral read proportions to all data

```{r}
summarize_viral_reads <- function(data){
  data %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    summarize(total_mapped=sum(set_read_count),
              total_reads=first(filtered_reads_in_sample),
              viral_reads_percentage=(total_mapped/total_reads)*100,
              .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(Year_cat=ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", sample_id), 
                          "2020-2021", "2024-2025"))
}
```

```{r}
pal <- c("#7B71B6", "#E06666")
#plot viral read proportion of all samples
plot_vread_percentage_all <- function(data){
  mean_val <- round(mean(data$viral_reads_percentage),3)
  median_val <- round(median(data$viral_reads_percentage),3)
  ggplot(data=data, aes(x="",y=viral_reads_percentage, fill=Year_cat)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y="Percentage",
         x="") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
          title = element_text(size=12),
          legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size=14)) + 
    facet_grid(~Year_cat)+
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25),
                       labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) 
}


#plot number of viral reads for all samples
plot_vread_number_all <- function(data){
  mean_val <- format(mean(data$total_mapped), 
                        scientific = T, digits = 6)
  median_val <- format(median(data$total_mapped), 
                          scientific =T, digits=6)
  
  ggplot(data=data, aes(x="",y=total_mapped, fill=Year_cat)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "Reads aligned to viral genomes",
         x="") +
    facet_grid(~Year_cat)+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
          title = element_text(size=12),
          legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size=14))
}

```

```{r}
v_reads_all <- summarize_viral_reads(esviritu_res)
```

```{r}
v_reads_all_plot <- plot_grid(plot_vread_percentage_all(v_reads_all),

```
Test the difference between the proportion and number of viral reads between years
```{r}
wilcox.test(viral_reads_percentage ~ Year_cat, data = v_reads_all)
wilcox.test(total_mapped ~ Year_cat, data = v_reads_all)
```

## Assembly coverage categories

Calculate the coverage per assembly with as a ratio of covered bases and assembly length

```{r}
calc_coverage_cats <- function(data){
  data %>%
  mutate(coverage = set_covered_bases/asm_length) %>%
  mutate(cov_category = case_when(
    coverage >= 0.8 ~ "> 80%",
    coverage < 0.8 & coverage >= 0.5 ~ "50%-80%",
    coverage < 0.5 & coverage >= 0.1 ~ "10%-50%",
    TRUE ~ "< 10%"
  ))
}

calc_coverage_cats_years <- function(data){
  data %>%
  mutate(Year_cat = ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", sample_id), 
                          "2020-2021", "2024-2025")) %>%
  group_by(Year_cat) %>%
  mutate(coverage = set_covered_bases/asm_length) %>%
  mutate(cov_category = case_when(
    coverage >= 0.8 ~ "> 80%",
    coverage < 0.8 & coverage >= 0.5 ~ "50%-80%",
    coverage < 0.5 & coverage >= 0.1 ~ "10%-50%",
    TRUE ~ "< 10%"
  ))
}

```

```{r}
plot_coverage_cat <- function(data, years=FALSE){

  if (years==FALSE){
    cols <- c("#fbb373", "#faa050", "#e19048", "#af7038")
  
  plot_data <- calc_coverage_cats(data) %>%
    group_by(sample_id, cov_category) %>%
    summarize(seqs = n_distinct(Accession)) %>%
    group_by(cov_category) %>%
    mutate(cov_category = factor(cov_category, levels = c("< 10%",
                                                        "10% to 50%",
                                                        "50% to 80%",
                                                        "Over 80%")))

  plot <- ggplot(data=plot_data, aes(x=cov_category, y=seqs, fill = cov_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "grey20", draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) +

  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "# virus references\nwith coverage level per sample",
       x = "Assembly coverage") +
  theme(legend.position = "Off",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        strip.text = element_text(size=10))
  
  return(plot)
  } else{
    cols_21 <- c("#7B71B6","#7B71B6", "#7B71B6", "#7B71B6" )
    cols_24 <- c("#E06666","#E06666", "#E06666", "#E06666" )
    
    plot_data <- calc_coverage_cats_years(data) %>%
      group_by(Year_cat, sample_id, cov_category) %>%
      summarize(seqs = n_distinct(accession)) %>%
      group_by(cov_category) %>%
      mutate(cov_category = factor(cov_category, levels = c("< 10%",
                                                        "10%-50%",
                                                        "50%-80%",
                                                        "> 80%")))
    
    plot_data$cat_facet <- paste(plot_data$cov_category, 
                                 plot_data$Year_cat, sep = "_")


    plot <- ggplot(data=plot_data, aes(x=cov_category, y=seqs, fill = cat_facet)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "grey20") +
    #xlim(c(0,150)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "virus references\nwith coverage level per sample (N)",
         x = "Assembly coverage") +
    facet_wrap(~Year_cat)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      setNames(cols_21, paste(c("< 10%","10%-50%","50%-80%","> 80%"), 
                              "2020-2021", sep = "_")),
      setNames(cols_24, paste(c("< 10%","10%-50%","50%-80%","> 80%"), 
                              "2024-2025", sep = "_"))
    )) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      setNames(cols_21, paste(c("< 10%","10%-50%","50%-80%","> 80%"), 
                              "2020-2021", sep = "_")),
      setNames(cols_24, paste(c("< 10%","10%-50%","50%-80%","> 80%"), 
                              "2024-2025", sep = "_"))
    )) +
    theme(legend.position = "Off",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size=11),
          strip.text = element_text(size=14))
  
  return(plot)
  }
}
```


```{r}

asm_coverage_cats
```

## Test difference between years

```{r}
cov_cats_years <- calc_coverage_cats_years(esviritu_res) %>%
      group_by(Year_cat, sample_id, cov_category) %>%
      #check that seqs = assemblies
      summarize(seqs = n_distinct(accession),
                assemblies=n_distinct(assembly)) %>%
      group_by(cov_category) %>%
      mutate(cov_category = factor(cov_category, levels = c("< 10%",
                                                        "10%-50%",
                                                        "50%-80%",
                                                        "> 80%")))



over50_cov_20_21 <- cov_cats_years %>%
  filter(Year_cat=="2020-2021",
         cov_category == "50%-80%" | cov_category == "> 80%")

over50_cov_24_25 <- cov_cats_years %>%
  filter(Year_cat=="2024-2025",
         cov_category == "50%-80%" | cov_category == "> 80%")

#chisq.test(over50_cov_24_25$seqs, over50_cov_20_21$seqs)

```

Test the difference between years in the number of assemblies with coverage > 50%

        <50%  |   >50%
20-21  ___a___|____b_____
24-25     c   |    d
```{r}
over50_20_21 <- cov_cats_years %>%
  filter(Year_cat == "2020-2021") %>%
  group_by(cov_category) %>%
  summarize(seqs=sum(seqs)) 

a <- sum(over50_20_21[over50_20_21$cov_category%in% c("10%-50%", "< 10%"), "seqs"])
b <- sum(over50_20_21[over50_20_21$cov_category%in% c("50%-80%", "> 80%"), "seqs"])

over50_24_25 <- cov_cats_years %>%
  filter(Year_cat == "2024-2025") %>%
  group_by(cov_category) %>%
  summarize(seqs=sum(seqs))

c <- sum(over50_24_25[over50_24_25$cov_category%in% c("10%-50%", "< 10%"), "seqs"])
d <- sum(over50_24_25[over50_24_25$cov_category%in% c("50%-80%", "> 80%"), "seqs"])


m <- matrix(c(a,b,c,d), nrow=2, byrow=TRUE)
rownames(m) <- c("2020-2021", "2024-2025")
colnames(m) <- c("<50%", ">50%")
m
chisq.test(m)
```
--> 2020-2021 has significantly more accessions with >50% coverage

Test the difference between years in the number of assemblies with coverage < 10%

        <10%  |   >10%
20-21  ___a___|____b____
24-25     c   |    d

```{r}
under10_20_21 <- cov_cats_years %>%
  filter(Year_cat == "2020-2021") %>%
  group_by(cov_category) %>%
  summarize(seqs=sum(seqs)) 

a <- sum(over50_20_21[over50_20_21$cov_category == "< 10%", "seqs"])
b <- sum(over50_20_21[over50_20_21$cov_category%in% c("10%-50%","50%-80%", "> 80%"), "seqs"])
a
b
under10_24_25 <- cov_cats_years %>%
  filter(Year_cat == "2024-2025") %>%
  group_by(cov_category) %>%
  summarize(seqs=sum(seqs))
c <- sum(over50_24_25[over50_24_25$cov_category == "< 10%", "seqs"])
d <- sum(over50_24_25[over50_24_25$cov_category%in% c("10%-50%","50%-80%", "> 80%"), "seqs"])


m <- matrix(c(a,b,c,d), nrow=2, byrow=TRUE)
rownames(m) <- c("2020-2021", "2024-2025")
colnames(m) <- c("<10%", ">10%")
m
chisq.test(m)
```

--> 2020-2021 significantly more assemblies with coverage <10%
